Certification Process

No Guesswork

Four steps: scoping, evals, audit, certification. Scoping starts with a gap assessment, ends with crisp work plan. You always know what's next and who owns it.

Begin Certification
Begin Certification

Scoping

Define which agent or system is being certified, the deployment context, and the relevant control domains. Gap assessment in 48 hours. Organizations are prepped to pass Red-Teaming against real-world risks and implement relevant AIUC-1 Controls.

  • AIUC-1 Creates Custom Tests
  • Locks in your AIUC-1 Standard Version for 1 Year
  • Agent Configuration and Interface Bounds

Evals

AIUC conducts thousands of real‑world scenarios testing against jailbreaks, prompt injection, data leakage, hallucinations, and unsafe tool calls. Red-teaming typically involves 1,000 to 5,000 different test scenarios.

  • Organization provides representative agent configs
  • AIUC-1 creates custom tests and conducts red-teaming
  • Organization Implements Controls
  • Quarterly retests on your AIUC-1 Standard Version

Audit

A full review of policy, operational and technical controls across the 6 domains of the standard, conducted by an accredited auditor such as Schellman and Coalfire.

  • Organization Provides Evidence
  • Third-Party Auditor reviews Evidence and Tests

Certification

The full AIUC‑1 audit report and certificate is issued, offering organizations comprehensive third‑party validation of their agent security, safety and reliability.

  • Certificate & Audit Report Issued
  • Valid for 1 Year
